newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian MinFins firm on US rate hike anticipation.
newsitem.headline: Russian MinFins firm on US rate hike anticipation.

text.p: MinFin bonds firmed in calm trading on Friday tracking the global trend in Brady bonds which are increasingly speculating on a modest rise in U.S. interest rise next week.
The U.S. Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meets on March 25 to discuss interest rates, and emerging debt markets have largely priced in a 25 basis-point hike in U.S. interest rates.

"Globally, the market is feeling relieved knowing U.S. rates are going up. As for Russia, the market is still quiet but it should catch up with the bullish trend as soon as the rate hike takes place," Eurobank dealer Olivier Coursault said.
Dealers said the market was otherwise calm ahead of the weekend but current prices were enjoying stable support, mainly from foreign operators.
"Some buying was seen as Treasuries look stronger. London is bidding firmly, somebody can be covering short positions," an ICFI Moscow Partners dealer said.
